label: Current glucose
why: lower glucose now is closer to 70
mechanism: The closer glucose is to 70, the less room there is before a low.

label: Lowest glucose, last hour
why: a lower recent minimum is closer to 70
mechanism: The closer glucose is to 70, the less room there is before a low.

label: Mean glucose, last hour
why: glucose running lower is closer to 70
mechanism: The closer glucose is to 70, the less room there is before a low.

label: Glucose trend, last 30 min
why: a falling trend (negative slope) raises the risk
mechanism: A falling trend means insulin is removing glucose faster than the liver and meals add it; a rising one, the reverse.

label: Glucose trend, last 60 min
why: a falling trend raises the risk
mechanism: A falling trend means insulin is removing glucose faster than the liver and meals add it; a rising one, the reverse.

label: Change over last 15 min
why: a recent drop raises the risk
mechanism: A falling trend means insulin is removing glucose faster than the liver and meals add it; a rising one, the reverse.

label: Last reading below 70
why: a recent low weakens counter-regulation, so a longer gap lowers the risk
mechanism: A recent low weakens the body's glucagon and adrenaline defence for a while, so another is more likely.

label: Time below 70, 6 h
why: more recent time below 70 raises the risk
mechanism: A recent low weakens the body's glucagon and adrenaline defence for a while, so another is more likely.

label: Steps, last hour
why: activity takes up glucose without insulin
mechanism: Working muscle takes up glucose without insulin, and insulin sensitivity stays higher for hours.

label: Steps, last 3 h
why: activity raises insulin sensitivity for hours
mechanism: Working muscle takes up glucose without insulin, and insulin sensitivity stays higher for hours.

label: Sulfonylurea dose
why: sulfonylureas release insulin regardless of glucose
mechanism: Sulfonylureas make the pancreas release insulin even when glucose is already low.

label: Insulin dose per kg
why: more injected insulin, more glucose lowering
mechanism: Injected insulin keeps lowering glucose whether or not food arrives; premixed insulin peaks hours after the dose.

label: On insulin
why: insulin can cause lows
mechanism: Injected insulin keeps lowering glucose whether or not food arrives; premixed insulin peaks hours after the dose.

label: Diabetes duration
why: long duration weakens glucagon and adrenaline defences
mechanism: Long diabetes and past severe lows weaken the glucagon and adrenaline defence, so lows go deeper.

label: Severe hypo in past 12 months
why: past severe lows mark weakened defences
mechanism: Long diabetes and past severe lows weaken the glucagon and adrenaline defence, so lows go deeper.

label: eGFR (kidney function)
why: better kidneys clear drugs faster
mechanism: Weaker kidneys clear sulfonylureas and insulin more slowly, so they act for longer.

label: HbA1c
why: on glucose-lowering drugs, lower HbA1c runs closer to 70
mechanism: On glucose-lowering drugs, a lower HbA1c means glucose runs closer to the low line.

label: Age
why: warning symptoms weaken and drugs clear more slowly with age
mechanism: With age, warning symptoms of a low weaken and drugs are cleared more slowly.

label: Current glucose
why: higher glucose now is closer to 180
mechanism: The closer glucose is to 180, the more likely it is to cross it.

label: Highest glucose, last hour
why: a higher recent peak is closer to 180
mechanism: The closer glucose is to 180, the more likely it is to cross it.

label: Glucose trend, last 30 min
why: a rising trend raises the risk
mechanism: A rising trend usually means a meal is still being absorbed; a falling one, that insulin is winning.

label: Change over last 15 min
why: a recent rise raises the risk
mechanism: A rising trend usually means a meal is still being absorbed; a falling one, that insulin is winning.

label: Largest 30-min rise, 3 h
why: a large recent rise signals a carbohydrate-heavy meal
mechanism: A large recent rise signals a carbohydrate-heavy meal.

label: Time above 180, 6 h
why: recent time above 180 shows glucose running high
mechanism: Recent highs show glucose is running high today.

label: Steps, last hour
why: activity pulls glucose into muscle
mechanism: Activity pulls glucose into muscle, which usually lowers the chance of a high.

label: HbA1c
why: a higher HbA1c means glucose runs higher
mechanism: A higher HbA1c means glucose runs higher on average.

label: BMI
why: more body fat, more insulin resistance
mechanism: More body fat goes with more insulin resistance, so meals raise glucose more.

label: Sulfonylurea dose
why: sulfonylureas lower glucose
mechanism: Sulfonylureas push insulin release, which lowers glucose.
